title: Europe Failed the Ceuta Test
gist: Zaki Laïdi argues the Ceuta migration crisis, in which over 70,000 Moroccans attempted to cross into the Spanish enclave and Italy responded by suspending visa-free travel from Spain, exposes the collapse of EU solidarity and shows hardline national measures cannot address the deeper structural forces driving migration.

themes.theme: Collapse of EU solidarity over migration

insights.claim: The current migration crisis is eating away at the solidarity on which the European Union depends, fueling the rise of the far right and pushing leaders toward increasingly hardline policies.
insights.speaker: ZakiLaidi
insights.so_what: Points to migration as an accelerant of EU political fragmentation and far-right gains, a factor relevant to European political risk and policy unpredictability.

insights.so_what: Suggests current EU border-control responses are likely to prove ineffective long-term fixes, implying continued recurring migration-driven political shocks in Europe.
